headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-Powered Risk Detection
summary: Integrate public trend signals to improve ClearInstall's risk detection capabilities, leveraging AI for more accurate and real-time binding.gyp command expansion analysis. Enhance user experience by providing detailed explanations of potential risks before installation.
actions: Implement AI models from projects like storytold/craft-anything to analyze and predict potential npm/PyPI package risks in real-time.
Utilize deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype for advanced command expansion detection, ensuring that all binding.gyp files are thoroughly checked for security v
Integrate explanations and context from projects like heydamir/unslop to provide users with clear, actionable insights on how to mitigate identified risks.
